tier_should.rationale: Combines reduced-form evidence with a multi-sector spatial GE model to quantify deforestation leakage in Brazil, finding limited leakage. Credible, policy-relevant contribution; modeling seems sound, though exposition is rough. Strong fit for environmental/spatial economics field journals.

tier_will.rationale: Presentation quality and identification details are uneven, lowering odds at top outlets. Nevertheless, timely and policy-relevant, with reasonable methods; likely to place in strong environmental economics field journals such as JEEM or JAERE.
